about: MeasurementEngine on synthetic signals (GoldenSignal), fed in 6000-sample blocks with SimClock; minutes and events in emission order

cases.name: tone_on_noise
cases.note: noise −70 dBFS, a 1 kHz tone 10–30 s; every tick and second; minute boundary 50 s in

cases.name: bursts
cases.note: bursts: normal, too short, across a minute boundary, a 60 Hz thump (wind), a 35 s long one, one below the floor; calibrated offset 120

cases.name: invalid_audio
cases.note: 2 s of exact zeros, 4 s of system-silenced mic (blocks starting 30–34 s) with a burst inside, one valid burst; zone UTC (ISO 'Z')

cases.name: clipping_dst
cases.note: a full-scale 1 kHz square wave (digital clipping) across the spring DST change 02:00 → 03:00

cases.name: clock_drift
cases.note: wall clock 1 % fast: re-anchoring once per minute; across midnight and the new year

cases.name: classifier
cases.note: classifier plumbing with the app's categories.json/yamnet_labels.txt and deterministic fake scores (SplitMix64(1000+k)·0.3, frame k%3==0: Motorcycle=0.6, k%3==1: Car=0.5)

cases.name: max_duration
cases.note: a 315 s tone: the event is force-closed at 300 s, minutes are held back until it is decided (emitted out of order)
